title.name: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion

scope.coverage_description: Original 2006 television anime and its second season R2, two seasons through 2008-09-28. Excludes recap/alternate-continuity films, Resurrection, and later spin-offs.

synopsis: Japan has been invaded and conquered by the Britannian Empire. Japan is now known as Area 11 and its citizens known as Elevens. The Britannian Empire takes away Japan's autonomous power and imposes its rule through the use of Knightmares. The Empire's rule has never faltered, but cracks have begun to show...
